name: Cloven Hoof
summary: Deep in Thousand Needles, the Galak centaur guard the Cloven Hoof within a sacred flame at Splithoof Hold. Tauren scholars seek to understand the strange energy rising from the relic.

sections.title: A Sacred Centaur Relic
sections.body: At the heart of Splithoof Hold, the Galak centaur keep the Cloven Hoof in an ancient brazier. Magical fire surrounds the relic, and blessed water must quench the flame for a moment before anyone can handle it. The centaur clans are divided and violent, yet their care for the brazier points to a ritual bound to their origins. At Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner and other tauren observers hope the strange aura of the hoof will teach them about the centaur who have long troubled Kalimdor's plains.

faq.q: Where is the Cloven Hoof kept?
faq.answer: The Cloven Hoof rests in an ancient brazier at the back of Splithoof Hold, a cavern in Splithoof Crag north of Freewind Post. Elite Galak warriors guard it.

faq.q: Why does Rau Cliffrunner want the Cloven Hoof?
faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner wants to study the Cloven Hoof to learn about centaur origins and magic. He senses strange energy from the relic and hopes it will reveal hidden truths about the hostile clans.

faq.q: How is the Cloven Hoof retrieved from the brazier?
faq.answer: Magical fire surrounds the Cloven Hoof, so it cannot be taken directly. Pour a phial of special water into the ancient brazier to quench the sacred flame briefly, then take the hoof before the blaze returns.

faq.q: Who are the Galak centaur guarding it?
faq.answer: The Galak are a centaur tribe that holds the northern reaches of Thousand Needles. Their stronghold is Splithoof Crag, where they fiercely guard their sacred fire from outsiders.

angles.text: For generations, the nomadic tauren have endured relentless centaur aggression. Learning the origins and magic of relics like the Cloven Hoof could offer knowledge of their old adversaries.
Ritual elements can briefly quench magical flames and let the Cloven Hoof be retrieved. Such work calls for careful spiritual study in Kalimdor.
